Synopsis:
Hope spirit appears to tell about Archive, Archivist and treasures inside

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_HouseOfHope_HopeSpirit02.json: You’ve found a frightened spirit called Hope in the House of Hope — she’s chatty, prone to outbursts, and desperate to warn you about the Archive ahead. Off‑screen the Archive holds a highly prized object called the Hammer and is protected by lethal alarms, traps and guardians; Hope insists that triggering those protections will draw Raphael and other dire consequences. Hope says the Archivist is the key to getting at the collection — he’s stubborn and apparently vulnerable to certain weaknesses that can be exploited — and that her sister Korrilla is inside the Archive acting nonchalant but likely up to something. Hope is also under the control of a jailor who might kill her if you don’t act, so the player is being urged to plan questions and use guile rather than try to steal the prize by force.
- LOW_HouseOfHope_Archivist_SpeakWithDead.json: SwD with Archivist (in House of Hope, Archive room)In this dialogue it's possible to learn about where Raphael keeps his "secrets"
- LOW_HouseOfHope_AD_ArchivistAlarmComment.json: If players will steal any treasure and call the alarm, the Archivist will comment on that
- LOW_HouseOfHope_HopeSpirit01.json: First dialogue with Hope's spirit that happens after players get to House of Hope.Hope is a captive within the House, and has been driven mad by years of psychological and physical torture. Raphael keeps her alive because she astonishes him - and the reason for that is that no matter what he does to her, she holds onto the last of her hope and optimism. That fascinates him.In this dialogue, Hope introduces players to the House of Hope. They have arrived here deliberately, knowing that they are not invited, and that it is likely dangerous.Hope appears to warn them of that danger, and to help them, and also introduces the deranged vibe of the area.Note: When Hope speaks in all-caps, she is showing the manic side of her personality. Louder, more intense, and almost like she's possessed by a different, more deranged version of herself.
- LOW_HouseOfGrief_OM_Shadowheart_COM.json: Attendant serving as the front desk for the House of Grief. Recognises Shadowheart and urges her to enter the room beyond and submit to the Mapping of the heart, and beyond it, her return to the Sharran grotto.

context: You’ve encountered a battered, talkative spirit called Hope imprisoned in the House of Hope; she’s been tortured and is desperate to warn you but can be driven into manic outbursts. Off‑screen the Archive lies ahead and contains the prized Hammer, but it’s defended by lethal alarms, traps and guardians — triggering them will draw Raphael and other dire consequences. Hope says the Archivist controls access to the collection: he’s stubborn but has exploitable fears and weaknesses (he is especially afraid of certain authority figures and visitors). Hope’s sister Korrilla is supposedly inside the Archive acting nonchalant and likely up to something, and Hope is under the control of a jailor who might kill her if you act rashly, so Hope urges planning, guile and careful questioning rather than brute theft.
